# Sentinel Global — Information Security & Acceptable Use Policy

**Document ID:** POL-SEC-2024-001  
**Effective Date:** February 15, 2024  
**Version:** 4.0  
**Owner:** Chief Information Security Office (CISO)  

---

metadata.section: Sentinel Global — Information Security & Acceptable Use Policy

text:
## 1. Scope & Objective
This policy governs security protocols regarding corporate data, network access, authentication, and endpoint devices assigned to personnel.

---

## 2. Authentication & Credential Standards

### 2.1 Password Requirements
* Minimum length of **12 characters**.
* Must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and at least one special symbol (!@#$%^&*).
* Mandatory password change interval is **90 days**.
* Passwords cannot match any of the previous 6 historical passwords.

### 2.2 Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
* MFA via hardware token (YubiKey) or approved authenticator application (Google Authenticator / Okta Verify) is **mandatory** for all corporate logins, Single Sign-On (SSO) portals, and VPN endpoints.
* SMS-based 2FA is explicitly deprecated and prohibited due to SIM-swapping vulnerabilities.

---

## 3. Device & Endpoint Security

### 3.1 Removable Storage & USB Media
* The use of external USB flash drives, memory cards, and unencrypted external hard drives on corporate workstations is **strictly prohibited**.
* USB data transfer ports are disabled at the OS level via MDM profile. Exemptions require formal CISO clearance and cryptographically verified storage.

### 3.2 Clean Screen & Inactivity Lock
* All laptops and workstations must automatically lock after **5 minutes** of inactivity.
* Employees must manually lock screens (Windows + L / Control + Command + Q) whenever leaving their work area unattended.

### 3.3 Remote Network Connection (VPN)
* Connecting to Sentinel internal resources from public or untrusted networks (airports, cafes, hotels) requires active connection to the corporate **WireGuard / GlobalProtect VPN**.
* Split-tunneling is strictly disabled.

metadata.section: Sentinel Global — Employee Leave & Time-Off Policy

text:
## 1. Overview
Sentinel Global is committed to supporting work-life balance while ensuring operational continuity. This document defines employee entitlement to statutory and discretionary leaves.

---
## 2. Categories of Leave

### 2.1 Privilege / Earned Leave (PL)
* **Accrual:** Full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of Privilege Leave per completed calendar month of active service (total 18 days per annum).
* **Accumulation & Carry Forward:** Employees may carry forward accrued PL year-on-year up to a hard ceiling of **45 days**.
* **Lapse Rule:** Any accrued PL exceeding 45 days as of December 31st automatically lapses without financial encashment.
* **Encashment:** Encashment is permissible only upon formal resignation or retirement, calculated against base monthly salary.

### 2.2 Casual Leave (CL)
* Entitlement: **12 days** per calendar year credited on January 1st.
* CL is intended for personal contingencies and short notice absences.
* Maximum consecutive CL allowed is 3 days.
* Unused CL cannot be carried forward to the subsequent calendar year and lapses on December 31st.

### 2.3 Sick & Medical Leave (SL)
* Entitlement: **10 days** per calendar year.
* Any consecutive sick leave exceeding **3 continuous working days** mandates a registered medical practitioner's fitness certificate submitted to HR within 48 hours of return.

### 2.4 Parental Leaves
* **Maternity Leave:** 26 continuous weeks of fully paid leave for female employees for up to two surviving children.
* **Paternity Leave:** 10 working days of fully paid leave, valid within 6 months following childbirth.

# Remote Work IT Security Policy
Section 1.1: Home Wi-Fi Standards
Employees working remotely must ensure their home Wi-Fi is protected with WPA3 encryption. Default router passwords must be changed immediately.

Section 1.2: VPN Mandatory Requirement
All access to internal company repositories and staging servers must be routed through the corporate WireGuard VPN at all times.

metadata.section: Sentinel Global — Corporate Travel & Expense Policy

text:
## 1. Purpose & Scope
This policy outlines the authorized expense limits, booking guidelines, and reimbursement procedures for Sentinel Global employees undertaking business travel. All domestic and international trips must be pre-approved by the respective Department Head via the Sentinel ERP portal.

---
## 2. Accommodation & Lodging Guidelines

### 2.1 Hotel Accommodation Limits
Employees travelling for approved business purposes can claim hotel accommodation up to **₹3,000 per night** (taxes inclusive).

* **Uniform Cap:** This limit of ₹3,000 per night applies uniformly across all domestic travel locations, cities, and regions. No exceptions or higher city tiers (including metropolitan zones such as Mumbai, Delhi NCR, or Bengaluru) are authorized under standard travel limits. Any booking exceeding ₹3,000 per night requires prior written sign-off from the Chief Financial Officer (CFO).
* **Booking Window:** Employees must book lodging at least 7 days prior to departure through the corporate travel desk.

### 2.2 Shared Accommodation
When two employees of the same gender travel together on company assignment, they are encouraged to share twin-occupancy rooms with an enhanced combined cap of ₹4,500 per night.

---

## 3. Daily Per Diem & Meals
Employees travelling outstation are entitled to a daily meal allowance of up to **₹800 per day**.
* Itemized tax invoices (GSTIN compliant) must accompany every claim.
* Alcohol, minibar charges, and personal laundry services are strictly non-reimbursable.

---

## 4. Transportation & Commute

### 4.1 Air Travel
* **Domestic:** Economy class only for flights under 6 hours duration.
* **International:** Economy class for flights under 8 hours; Premium Economy for flights exceeding 8 hours with VP approval.

### 4.2 Local City Transit
* Employees may claim app-based taxi rides (e.g., Uber / Ola) up to **₹500 per day** for direct transit between hotel, client offices, and transit hubs.
* Auto-rickshaw and public metro expenses are fully reimbursable upon submitting valid receipts or transit cards statement.

---

## 5. Expense Submission & Reimbursement Deadlines
All travel expense reports must be submitted within **30 days** of the conclusion of the business trip.
* Claims submitted after 30 days will be automatically rejected by the automated payroll engine.
* Original digital or scanned receipts must be uploaded for any item exceeding ₹100.

• Type: Animated_Slide
• Description: Why Classical Scaling Reaches Limits
• Talking Points: A classical computer represents information with bits, each ﬁxed as either 0 or 1,

processed by billions of transistor switches..Like a radar processing unit, it takes input signals, ﬁlters
noise, performs calculations, and produces usable information such as target range or velocity..Clas-
sical systems became more capable as transistors grew smaller, faster, and more densely packed,
increasing the amount of processing available in a compact device..Classical sensors also convert

quantities such as acceleration, magnetic ﬁeld, temperature, or position into electrical signals, yet
must contend with noise, interference, resolution limits, and environmental disturbance..Classical
technology remains essential, but when physical or practical limits dominate, controlled quantum
states may oﬀer a diﬀerent way to approach selected problems.
• Type: Animated_Slide
• Description: What Makes Quantum Technology Diﬀerent from Classical Technology

• Description: What Makes Quantum Technology Diﬀerent from Classical Technology
• Talking Points: Classical electronics encode information as bits with deﬁnite values, like a switch
that is either ON or OFF..A radar processor can manipulate bit sequences such as 101101 to estimate
range, velocity, and position from received signals..A qubit is a controlled quantum state that can
contain contributions from both 0 and 1 until measurement produces one deﬁnite outcome..Superpo-

sition, entanglement, measurement, and coherence enable interference, correlations, and precision
eﬀects that classical switches cannot reproduce..Quantum technology is not automatically faster for
radar data or every task, but can oﬀer advantages when a problem exploits these speciﬁc quantum
properties.
